ideas.idea: Image /img/reception.jpg likely missing; add file and passthrough copy
ideas.why: .eleventy.js only copies robots.txt and sitemap.xml and no img folder exists, so the image would 404.

ideas.idea: Expand Dentist JSON-LD with address, url, openingHours, sameAs
ideas.why: The JSON-LD has only name and phone, and the address is on the page, so richer data helps machines identify the practice.

ideas.idea: Add opening hours as visible text on the contact page
ideas.why: The contact page gives no hours, and this is a concrete, site-specific gap for patients and machines.

ideas.idea: Back 'Trusted by thousands of local patients' claim with concrete evidence
ideas.why: This is a valid content-quality point, but it is general copy advice with little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add actual prices or 'from' prices on services
ideas.why: The services page says prices are 'simple and clear' but lists none, so adding them gives users and machines real facts.

ideas.idea: Team page should list each dentist with name, role and qualifications
ideas.why: The team page has only a vague sentence and no people, so named profiles add real, extractable content.

ideas.idea: Create separate pages for implants and whitening
ideas.why: Services is a bare four-item list, so dedicated pages would give each treatment content that can be found and understood.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: It's accurate, but lastmod has little effect on a four-URL site.

ideas.idea: Add og:title and og:description social tags
ideas.why: It's accurate, but the tags are boilerplate and have little effect on findability.
The layout has none, but the Dentist data already covers the entity, so a separate WebSite/Organization block adds little.

ideas.idea: Add an emergency care section or page with out-of-hours number
ideas.why: The home page promotes emergency appointments but gives no detail or number, so this is a concrete content gap.
